notes.title: 🧨 Update 0.3 – More Immersion, New Raids & the First Interrior!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’ve been working hard on preparing [b]Update 0.3[/b], and I’m really excited to share what’s coming next for [i]CriminalZ[/i]. This update focuses heavily on [b]immersion[/b] and introduces the [b]very first playable interrior[/b].
[/p][h3]🔊 A More Immersive Experience[/h3][p]To enhance the feel of the world, I’ve been improving the overall [b]player experience[/b] — especially during looting. Looting is now more satisfying, thanks to new [b]sound effects[/b] and [b]UI feedback[/b]. Each item pickup should feel impactful, and it’s now clearer what kind of loot you've found.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e4b3f7d7d49f895d707a84a1b73070078ad8ef65.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/b524004a16456df47b0669fc574371909c3c7249.png"][/img][/p][h3]
👊 Boss Interface Overhaul[/h3][p]The [b]boss UI[/b] has also been redesigned. Before each new stage, players will now receive a [b]short message at the top of the screen[/b] telling them what’s changed in the current wave. Every stage is now more challenging — but also [b]more rewarding[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/8b2c2f8d3a5e88d38885fd815a293dc5afbad84b.png"][/img][/p][h3]
🌌 Raid Portals Reworked[/h3][p]I’ve completely changed the [b]portal visuals and sounds[/b]. Entering a raid should now feel more like [b]"We’re about to hit this place hard!"[/b]
Portals can now spawn in [b]different rarities[/b] — and the rarer the portal, the [b]better the loot[/b] you’ll find inside. Get ready to hunt for those high-tier raids!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/e2047acdb602aaa1d2545672d214ef54d2d6cdd7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/3aa7f4c6b96be79120f6c4cb4fa909b3c8745f09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657625/a6b2a71a454bd324143481486a8ff735687f75ca.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you’ve got [b]questions[/b], want to [b]share your ideas[/b], or just hang out with other players, be sure to [b]join our Discord[/b].

[url="https://discord.gg/fh6vPGekTd"]https://discord.gg/fh6vPGekTd[/url]

I’d love to hear your feedback — it helps me shape the future of the game![/p][p]Thanks for all your support. –
CriminalZ Dev[/p]
